import json
data = json.load\(open\('logs/conversations_session_20260208_124547/conversation_session_20260208_124547_iter025.json'\)\)
total_text = 0
total_images = 0
print\("Message content analysis:"\)
for i, msg in enumerate\(data['messages']\):
    print\(f"\\nMessage {i} \({msg['role']}\):"\)
    for j, block in enumerate\(msg['content']\):
        if 'text' in block:
            text_len = len\(block['text']\)
            total_text += text_len
            snippet = block['text'][:100].replace\('\\n', ' '\)
            print\(f"  Text block {j}: {text_len} chars - \\"{snippet}...\\""\)
        elif 'image' in block:
            total_images += 1
            img_size = len\(block['image']['source']['bytes']\)
            print\(f"  Image block {j}: {img_size} bytes"\)
        elif 'toolUse' in block:
            tool_name = block['toolUse'].get\('name', 'unknown'\)
            print\(f"  Tool use block {j}: {tool_name}"\)
        elif 'toolResult' in block:
            tool_id = block['toolResult'].get\('toolUseId', 'unknown'\)
            result_content = block['toolResult'].get\('content', []\)
            for k, res in enumerate\(result_content\):
                if 'text' in res:
                    res_len = len\(res['text']\)
                    total_text += res_len
                    res_snippet = res['text'][:100].replace\('\\n', ' '\)
                    print\(f"  Tool result {j}.{k}: {res_len} chars - \\"{res_snippet}...\\""\)

print\(f"\\n\\nTOTAL:"\)
print\(f"Text: {total_text} chars \(~{total_text // 4} tokens\)"\)
print\(f"Images: {total_images} \(~{total_images * 1400} tokens\)"\)
print\(f"Estimated total: ~{\(total_text // 4\) + \(total_images * 1400\)} tokens"\)
